about.title: A bit about me
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Aravindhan Govindaraj. I'm a Full Stack Engineer with 4.5+ years of progressive ownership across backend systems, scalable UI architecture, and data workflows — delivering measurable impact at McKesson and Infosys.

Promoted twice within Infosys, I grew from a feature contributor to a Technology Analyst owning end-to-end delivery on enterprise platforms. I am known for backend performance work that cut query latency by 45%, automation that eliminated 70% of manual operations, and frontend architecture that reduced production defects by 25%.

timeline.title: Technology Analyst (Full Stack)
bullets: Led development of high-volume licensing workflow automation for Supply Manager, eliminating 70% manual operations and improving compliance reliability across 10K+ monthly transactions.
Optimized large dataset SQL workflows, reducing query latency by 45% and stabilizing API response SLAs for 10K+ concurrent users.
Engineered REST APIs in Spring Boot to support multi-step data validation processes, improving backend reliability in latency-sensitive workflows.
Coordinated deployments and release approvals with cross-functional product and infrastructure teams, ensuring zero-downtime roll-outs.

timeline.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Full Stack)
bullets: Modernized Java and Angular applications to LTS versions (Java 21, Angular 16), cutting build times and reducing dependency conflicts.
Built a shared UI component library (15+ reusable Angular components) and service-based RxJS state flows, reducing code duplication by 20% and ensuring predictable data propagation across modules.
Developed SQL stored procedures to detect and resolve adjustment errors in bulk claim data processing, reducing healthcare claim inaccuracies by 15%.
Created automated ETL API workflows for generating source-to-target mappings, reducing manual mapping time.

timeline.title: Systems Engineer (Full Stack)
bullets: Implemented Angular reactive form validation and custom field-level verification logic, reducing bad data entry in production by 25%.
Delivered 90% unit test coverage across core UI components using Jasmine/Karma, preventing regressions and improving release confidence.

personal.title: Dark Data Archaeologist (DDA)
personal.description: GCP-native 5-agent AI pipeline that transforms 20 years of enterprise dark data into a queryable knowledge graph, targeting $3–5M in pricing intelligence.
bullets: Designed a 5-agent orchestration pipeline on GCP (Cloud Run + Pub/Sub) that ingests and indexes unstructured enterprise assets (PDFs, contracts, emails, audio) at scale.
Architected hybrid RAG retrieval combining Vertex AI Vector Search for semantic recall and BigQuery graph traversal for relationship-aware queries, with Gemini 2.5 Flash as the synthesis layer.
Enforced production-grade reliability with confidence scoring thresholds, Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review gates, and immutable audit trails persisted in Cloud Firestore.
Built a cost-optimization routing layer that bypasses Document AI for directly parseable documents, reducing unnecessary API calls and pipeline cost.
Integrated Document AI, Speech-to-Text API, Gemini Embeddings, and BigQuery into a single event-driven pipeline.
